◈ Notation Lab

Tracked QR print sheet

Print these codes for posters, handouts, noticeboards and cards. Each code opens the same top-level app and carries a unique offline campaign label.

notationlab.pages.devFree sheet-music practice
Print at 100% scale
Tracking status: every code opens the same top-level Notation Lab page so visitors can choose their own tab. Each code carries a unique utm_content placement value. The site currently has no first-party analytics dashboard, so these labels are ready for Analytics or server-log reporting but do not by themselves create a traffic report. AdSense does not provide QR-scan attribution.
